subject.title: fix(agent-tools): add request timeout to remote media fetches

question: Should image, image-generation, and PDF agent-tool downloads adopt a fixed 15-minute response-header deadline?
rationale: The header-only primitive is technically appropriate, but the duration intentionally changes established behavior for exceptionally slow upstreams and needs owner acceptance.

options.title: Adopt 15 minutes
options.body: Accept the compatibility boundary for the three actual remote-fetching tools after removing video scope and consolidating the shared seam.

options.title: Choose another deadline
options.body: Select a different owner-approved duration before landing the caller changes.

recommendation.title: Adopt 15 minutes
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility boundary for the three actual remote-fetching tools after removing video scope and consolidating the shared seam.

likelyOwner.reason: He carried and merged both the shared header-timeout mechanism and the cited 15-minute bounded-media precedent.
